title: textdatarecordsindexingstatus
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

entityname.description: Entity name that identifies which entity does this record belong to.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

indexingstatus.description: Unstructured / Text data indexing status of entity - attribute - recordId combination.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

objecttypecode.description: Object type code of the entity that identifies which entity does this record belong to.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

recordcreatedonincrm.description: Created on of the record in CRM / Dataverse.

recordmodifiedonincrm.description: Modified on of the record in CRM / Dataverse.

recordsizeinbytesincrm.description: Size of record in bytes in CRM

recordsizeinbytesintextdataindex.description: Size of record in bytes in Unstructured / Text data search index

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
